title: 1963 Grade 4 Rhythm band, directed by Myrtle York
description: Entering grade four with our teacher, Hazel Nicholson, and music teacher, Myrtle York, meant joining the Rhythm Band. Each student wore a red cape and a top hat held on with elastic, and everyone was given an instrument to play. We practiced on the stage during music class until Mrs. York felt we were ready to perform at assemblies and the music festival. This is the class of 1962.
